discription: A pulse wave synth with width modulation and ADSR envelope.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, pulseWidth=0.5, pwRate=2; var sig; var env = EnvGen.ar( Env.adsr(0.01, 0.2, 0.7, 0.8, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2 ); var pwLFO = SinOsc.kr(pwRate).range(0.1, 0.9); sig = Pulse.ar(freq, pwLFO) * amp * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
